prompt: Now show the same list in EUR only.

results.text: Filtered to EUR, the list is empty: Synthetic Entity 01 holds only a USD position, so it has no EUR payments in the next funding window. I have not substituted another currency.

sql.command: SELECT queued_payment_id, amount_usd FROM aa_funding_window WHERE entity_id = 'ENT-01' AND currency = 'EUR' AND in_next_funding_window = 1
